demo.title: Permissions System Demo
demo.description: This page demonstrates how to use permission guards throughout the application.
demo.singleDescription: Elements wrapped in PermissionGuard are completely hidden if the user lacks permission.
demo.singleAllowed: You have USER_PERMISSIONS.LIST_ALL, so this element is visible.
demo.singleDenied: This element needs fake:permission, so it stays hidden.
demo.allDescription: Use the permissions prop to require ALL listed permissions.
demo.allAllowed: You have both USER_PERMISSIONS.LIST_ALL and ROLE_PERMISSIONS.LIST_ALL.
demo.allDenied: This element stays hidden because fake:permission is missing.
demo.anyDescription: Use the anyPermissions prop to show if user has ANY of the listed permissions.
demo.anyAllowed: Your session permissions include READ_ALL or READ_OWN.
demo.actionsDescription: Wrap action buttons with PermissionGuard to completely hide unauthorized actions.
demo.tip: Buttons are completely hidden to prevent users from seeing actions they cannot perform.
demo.fallbackDescription: Use the fallback prop to show alternative content when permission is denied.
demo.fallbackDenied: You don't have permission to view this content.
demo.secretContent: This secret content is only for authorized users!
demo.wildcardDescription: The wildcard permission grants access to everything. Only assign it to administrators with full access.
demo.wildcardNotice: The wildcard permission gives access to every resource and action.
